## Windows installer

**Download:** [NetDefenseOpsConsole-Setup-1.1.0.exe](attach from build)

Per-user install to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\NetDefenseOpsConsole`. Visual simulation only.

## Portable

**Download:** [NetDefenseOpsConsole-1.1.0-portable.zip](attach from build)

Extract and run `NetDefenseOpsConsole.exe`. No install required.
